name: Psionic Energy Dice
desc: Psionic Energy Dice: twice your Proficiency Bonus, regained all on a Long Rest and one on a Short Rest; the die grows with level (d6, d8 at 5, d10 at 11, d12 at 17). Psi-Bolstered Knack: if you fail an ability check using a skill or tool you're proficient with, you can roll one die and add it, possibly turning the failure into a success; the die is expended only if you succeed. Psychic Whispers (Magic action): telepathy with up to your Proficiency Bonus creatures for hours equal to the die roll; the first use after a Long Rest is free, later uses expend a die.
